steps.name: Jirou
steps.text: No, Madame Oni! I can't let you go any further!

steps.name: 'Oni'
steps.text: I have to kill that man.

steps.name: Jirou
steps.text: The oyabun told me himself, I can't let you get any closer!

steps.name: 'Oni'
steps.text: There's no time... Out of the way, Jirou. Last warning.

steps.name: Jirou
steps.text: Madame Oni!!!

steps.name: 'Oni'
steps.text: Even you're getting in my way now, Jirou?

steps.name: Jirou
steps.text: I know I can't. I just want one last drink with you, okay?

steps.name: Jirou
steps.text: I'm not trying to buy time, just... just one drink. When we're done, we can get back to killing each other.
The yakuza pulls out a bottle of sake and pours two cups, while the woman known as 'Madame Oni' silently watches on.

steps.name: Jirou
steps.text: Drink already.
Madame Oni lifts her head, the sake falling straight into her belly, but rather than a gentle warmth, a raging fire burns in her like a twisted knife.

steps.name: 'Oni'
steps.text: Jirou! You—!

steps.name: Jirou
steps.text: I've got to protect him.

steps.name: Jirou
steps.text: He might be your enemy, but he's always been good to me.

steps.name: Jirou
steps.text: If he dies here, he's only going to be my benefactor. If he lives, he'll become the benefactor for all of Mitsukue. Sorry, Madame Oni.

steps.name: 'Oni'
steps.text: GRAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!
The pain in her belly becomes a raging inferno that churns together with the fury in her mind, bursting its way out of her chest.

Unlike the chivalrous yakuza who walked against the flow, who knew right from wrong and believed in the justice she had always upheld, now, she has devolved into a vicious Oni, one who knows nothing but slaughter.

The Hannya in her hands can no longer be controlled by the great wisdom in scripture it is named for. All that is left is a frenzied fury that burns hotter than the face of Hannya, uncaring of former friendships.

steps.name: 'Oni'
steps.text: Hyaaah!

steps.name: Yakuza A
steps.text: Madame Oni?!

steps.name: Yakuza A
steps.text: Gugh!

steps.name: Yakuza B
steps.text: Stop her—

steps.name: Yakuza B
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Yakuza C
steps.text: S-She's gone mad—

steps.name: 'Oni'
steps.text: All who get in my way... must die.

steps.name: Diet Candidate
steps.text: Time, transformation, the general welfare...

steps.name: Diet Candidate
steps.text: These words must ring hollow to you. Belaboring the subject would not bring you redemption...

steps.name: Diet Candidate
steps.text: Vicious Oni.

steps.name: 'Oni'
steps.text: Shut up...

steps.name: 'Oni'
steps.text: SHUT UPPPPPPP!!!

a.text: Like A Yakuza: Birth of the Vicious Oni

spans.text: Like A Yakuza: Birth of the Vicious Oni

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Young Fan
steps.text: No pushing! Are you trying to flatten everyone or something?

steps.name: Young Fan
steps.text: That giant uchiwa you've got, lift it up high!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Uchiwa?

steps.name: Young Fan
steps.text: Y'know, a fan you wave to show how big a fan you are. Isn't that board you got there a real big one? Making it a triangle's pretty creative. How long has Momo-cchi been your oshi?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Momo-cchi?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...Sorry, just trying to get through. I'm in a hurry.

steps.name: Hyped Audience
steps.text: Momoka! Momoka! Momoka!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Thank you everyone! Thank you so much!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I am so honored that my first role on the big screen got to be the leading lady in Birth of the Vicious Oni—the Nameless Oni!

spans.text: I am so honored that my first role on the big screen got to be the leading lady in

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I've always been fascinated by the Nameless Oni, as she's the subject of a kaidan tale that's been going around Mitsukue for ages.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: An Oni with a single horn who rebels in the name of vengeance, wiping out an entire yakuza family in a berserk rage, before finally killing the candidate for the Diet she swore a blood feud against.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (Blood feud?)

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: But after realizing just how bloodstained her hands had become, she couldn't bear the guilt, ultimately committing suicide.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (Suicide?)

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Her endless resentment meant she couldn't be reborn, so she became a specter roaming the streets. Vowing to bury the truth in the dark, she suffers no witness to live...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (Has the story really grown that much...?)

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: It's a terrifying and tragic story, but it's also a touching one. And now, it's finally out on the silver screen for all to see!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: This movie means a lot to me. The people of Kajimachi were so kind to me when we were filming there, so I'd like to thank them while I have the chance.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'd also like to take this opportunity to talk about Shin Onibugyou, coming out this winter!

spans.text: I'd also like to take this opportunity to talk about

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'll be playing the lead Onihappou-no-Take, giving everyone a whole new take on the Onibugyou story.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: It'll have a few Birth of the Vicious Oni-related easter eggs and references too. I really can't tell you too much right now... but I hope you all go and watch it too!

spans.text: -related easter eggs and references too. I really can't tell you
much right now... but I hope you all go and watch it too!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Next, we have our very last song for this show, the ED for Birth of the Vicious Oni...

spans.text: Next, we have our very last song for this show, the ED for

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Kishoumon Nocturne, hope you all like it!
It is a slow song. The moment the music starts, the crowd quiets down.

The singer has already belted out an entire concert's worth of songs, the beads of sweat running down her neck just barely perceptible, but she strives to keep her breathing steady, singing to the gentle violin.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...Plot of the film aside, the song's pretty good. This 'Momo-cchi' has a great singing voice too.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Shame I don't have time for a break right now.
Hoshiguma turns her head towards the perimeter of the crowd.
Peering over the heads of hundreds, no, thousands of fans, she is looking to spy a target before the target spies her—
Unfortunately, at that very moment, they lock eyes.

steps.name: Anxious Police Officer
steps.text: There she is!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Gah!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: 'Scuse me, I need to switch places.

steps.name: Young Fan
steps.text: Eh? Wha—?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: If you're not going to move, I'll push my way through.

steps.name: Young Fan
steps.text: I don't understand—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sorry, pal.
The Oni woman lifts her 'uchiwa' up high. It is only at this point that the young fan notices the cold glint of steel shining off it.
Before he even has time to react, he is pushed aside by some monstrous force. The tall Oni has barged past him, and now she is only a few steps away from the stage.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Alone in this land, we all float on by♪

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Our fleeting tender moments, cause such deep sighs♪

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Let me forever gaze into your eyes♪

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Looking at life's dawn and dusk, so filled with dreams♪

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Thank you, everyone! Thank you all for listening!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: That was the last song I have for you today—

steps.name: Hyped Fans
steps.text: Encore! Encore! Encore!

steps.name: Kajimachi Resident
steps.text: Momoka! Momoka! Here! Over here!
Amidst the surging crowd of fans, one is particularly excited. She lifts something up high, having done all she can to squeeze through the crowd to reach the stage.

steps.name: Kajimachi Resident
steps.text: Momoka! I-I live in Kajimachi, I was even an extra in Birth of the Vicious Oni.

spans.text: Momoka! I-I live in Kajimachi, I was even an extra in

steps.name: Kajimachi Resident
steps.text: This is a picture you took with us extras when we were wrapping up filming. I always wanted to give it to you, but never had the chance... Please, take it!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Kajimachi? You're...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Even Kajimachi has star-chasers like her these days? I thought only old geezers lived there—
As she muses, Hoshiguma inadvertently spots out the corner of her eye several men, very much not dressed like fans, heading towards the Kajimachi girl.
They don't look like plainclothes security either. She might even say they look more like... yakuza?
Just as they are about to grab hold of her, Momoka suddenly pulls her up onto the stage.

steps.name: Passionate Fans
steps.text: WHOOOOOOOO! MOMOKA!
The fans, lost to hype, rush the stage, making the already-cramped venue even more impenetrable.
Up on stage, the sparkling idol cups her hands around her fan's.

steps.name: Kajimachi Resident
steps.text: I-I-I... Y-Y-You...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Could you tell me your name?

steps.name: Kajimachi Resident
steps.text: R-Right! Kichisei! I'm Kichisei!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'm sure I've seen you before...

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: You remember me? Tha—, well, wh-what did I even do that was so memorable, Momoka-san?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Hmm... This might be embarrassing, but you're the first person I've met who actually likes film set bentos...

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: That's because the rice is so good—Wait, wait... You saw that? No, nonono...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I put my own on the table next to you, so I got to watch you happily eat your sixth box.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: (Deep bow) I'm so sorry—!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: No, please, there's no need, I just meant—
As the girl leans forward, she loses her balance, stumbling into Momoka's embrace. Seeing her give one of her fans a big hug, the crowd goes wild.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Hey now, watch your step.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: So, how is Kajimachi right now? Is everyone doing okay?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Kajimachi... Right now, it... It...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: The pachinko parlor's not seeing as much business as it used to. Most people who want to stay out of trouble have moved away, and they're shooting Shin Onibugyou in a big fancy sound stage studio...

spans.text: The pachinko parlor's not seeing as much business as it used to. Most people who want to stay out of trouble have moved away, and they're shooting
in a big fancy sound stage studio...

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: No, wait, what I'm trying to say is that I'm here on Kajimachi's behalf to invite you back! Everyone would love to see you again!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Eh? Really? I'll gladly go, and I'll gladly see what I can do! I'll do anything I can for Kajimachi's sake!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: (Whisper) Kichisei-san, security's almost here. You can leave from the side.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: (Whisper) Th-Thank you, Momoka-san!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: THANKS FOR THE PHOTO!
Momoka turns to look at her backup band. The lead keyboardist gives her a nod.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Then... Thank you everyone for your passion and energy! It really means a lot to me!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: So I'd like to ask everyone to wait a little bit longer, and let the band have a moment to catch their breath.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'll be back on stage in two minutes to give you all the perfect curtain call!
The venue lights slowly fade out.
But the darkness does not stop the crowd's fervent chatter. Hoshiguma takes the opportunity to haul herself up on stage, trying to leave the venue as fast as possible.
Who just stepped on me?!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ugh.

steps.name: Dubious Man
steps.text: Who're you?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (Isn't this one of the guys chasing Kichisei? Guess they really were plainclothes security.)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Just looking to head out, nothing else. It's too crowded down there.

steps.name: Dubious Man
steps.text: Don't you fans pay a lot of money to be in a crowd like that?

steps.name: Dubious Man
steps.text: Wait, I bet you're the type of messed-up fan who goes onstage to bother the talent!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I really am just trying to head out—

steps.name: Dubious Man
steps.text: You really didn't check who's in charge of Momoka-san's agency?! Stay right there!

steps.name: Dubious Man
steps.text: Hey, what the—?! The hell is this thing... A metal shield?!

steps.name: Dubious Man
steps.text: Report, we've got trouble! There's someone on the stage—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Going to have to ask you to shut it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I need to get out of here quick. If I end up chased by both security and the police—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'm coming back on stage now, thank you everyone for waiting—
The lights turn on.
The two people up on stage look at each other with surprise, an unconscious man slumped on the floor between them.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: An Oni with... a single horn?!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: From the legend? The 'Nameless Oni' kaidan legend?!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Eek! G-Get back! Don't haunt me!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Stay away from meeeeeee!!!
As the crowd looks on, the one-horned Oni turns towards backstage, while Momoka huddles against the floor, shielding her head with her hands.
The lighting director cuts the lights, but it's no use. It only takes five seconds of silence before the venue devolves into complete bedlam.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: *phew*... Finally got out of there.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Even if you account for the chaos, the encore should be over by now. The police will be on my trail soon enough.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Should I go meet them?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No, I should at least head back to Kajimachi first to see the old man. Who knows how much the place has changed in twenty years.

steps.name: Repeating Broadcast
steps.text: Ding, dong, ding, Lingones Department Store♪

steps.name: Repeating Broadcast
steps.text: Everything you want, you'll find it here, Lingones Department Store♪

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (...Lingones Department Store? Wasn't it called Yamazakiya?)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (Did they extend the store so much it blocked the road?)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (Looks like I need to go inside to pass through.)

steps.name: Eager Staff
steps.text: Why don't you come in for a drink? You look like you can handle your liquor, and we just got some high-quality whiskey—

steps.name: Eager Staff
steps.text: Or if you would prefer a more old-school choice, we also have a fine collection of imo shochu...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No thank you.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (Behind the store, there should be—)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (Blocked up too?)

steps.name: Fashionable Man
steps.text: Take this, ojou-san.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Fashionable Man
steps.text: No, you definitely need it. You need to be guided to the most precious thing on Terra, the stepping stone to 'happiness'.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: A flier for a host club? I definitely don't need this.

spans.text: A flier for a host club? I

steps.name: Fashionable Man
steps.text: Ah, whatever, it just seemed like you were looking for something. Anything I can help with?

steps.name: Fashionable Man
steps.text: What did you happen to lose here in this bustling street of entertainment?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The way home.

steps.name: Fashionable Man
steps.text: I never expected valiant ladies like you to have days when they were lost. But no matter—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Were all the alleys from Nita Street to Kajimachi blocked off? Can you only go using the main road now?

steps.name: Fashionable Man
steps.text: No need to be so hasty in going back—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Looks like there wasn't any point in asking.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They're still scanning the crowd... They haven't seen me yet.
Hoshiguma finds a perfectly unremarkable wall to sit down against. True enough, two police officers keep their eyes on the crowd, walking right past her without a second glance.

Most of the credit goes to the people she is sharing the wall with, a majority of them drunken office workers. Some of them lean against the wall to vomit, while others simply hunch over to puke onto the street.

As for those who want to entertain themselves in the entertainment district through means outside of alcohol, they appear as if on an infinite conveyor belt, a near-infinite supply of them on an endless loop.
She is pretty sure she saw this group of people walk past her not five minutes ago.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Just about time to go.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Taishou, that one-horned Oni... Are you sure she isn't the kaidan from the legend here to haunt me?

spans.text: Taishou, that one-horned Oni... Are you
she isn't the kaidan from the legend here to haunt me?

steps.name: Yatai Vendor
steps.text: The kaidan from the tales aren't like the ghosts you're thinking of, relax.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: B-But what else could that have been? A ghost is the only explanation...

steps.name: Yatai Vendor
steps.text: If she was a ghost, why'd she run off without you doing anything?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Yatai Vendor
steps.text: If she didn't follow you, then the only explanation is pure coincidence. She's got nothing to do with you.

steps.name: Yatai Vendor
steps.text: You're better off worrying about other things. From what you said, Mio-san would have to take responsibility for the big ruckus today.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Mio-san? No, her job is to keep me safe, and I'm fine, at least.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Anyway, just in case the ghost is real... It's not like anyone upstairs can blame her for failing to stop a ghost, right?

spans.text: Anyway, just in case the ghost
real... It's not like anyone upstairs can blame her for failing to stop a ghost, right?

steps.name: Yatai Vendor
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Yatai Vendor
steps.text: Here. Your chikuwa, daikon, and burdenbeast tendon.
The radiant Momoka on stage is now just a young woman venting her frustrations, sniffling back tears before using one hand to lift her mask...
And her other to bring a bamboo skewer to her mouth, biting off a chunk of chikuwa to chew on.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Phew.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'm still scared, Taishou—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (I'll wait here at this yatai for a bit.)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (...Smells good.)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Taishou, I'll have a boiled fowlbeast egg, a piece of atsu-age, and a kombu knot.

steps.name: Yatai Vendor
steps.text: Coming right up.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I just need to head that way to get to Kajimachi, right?

steps.name: Yatai Vendor
steps.text: That's right. Got work there, okyaku-sama?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Just dropping by for a visit—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: YOU! YOU'RE THAT—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Taishou! Look! Sh-She really did follow me!

steps.name: Yatai Vendor
steps.text: Well—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'm begging you, please don't haunt me, ghost-san! When I was playing you, I really really REALLY did my best! If you're not happy with my performance, I can ask for a reshoot—

spans.text: I'm begging you, please don't haunt me, ghost-san! When I was playing you, I really
REALLY did my best! If you're not happy with my performance, I can ask for a reshoot—

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Wait, no! The film's already out, it's too late for that!

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I'm actually really scared of kaidan, ghost-san! I didn't mean to offend you!

steps.name: Target-Seeking Police Officer
steps.text: Who's shouting? Is something going on over there?

steps.name: Target-Seeking Police Officer
steps.text: You really led us on a wild fowlbeast chase, Hoshiguma-san. Still going to resist arrest?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hardly. I wasn't planning on resisting in the first place.

steps.name: Target-Seeking Police Officer
steps.text: Hands where I can see them.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: What just happened?

steps.name: Yatai Vendor
steps.text: What do you mean, 'what just happened'?

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: I must be dreaming...

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Why did the police just... arrest the ghost?
